fluff.overview: ComStar's infantry served across the Inner Sphere in garrison and security roles, stationed on HPG compound worlds where they provided protection for the Order's most critical infrastructure while maintaining the facade of a purely defensive force. Mechanized hover platoons are among the fastest conventional infantry formations fielded, using hovercraft transports that can cross water and open terrain at speeds that wheeled and tracked vehicles cannot match. ComStar favored hover-mechanized infantry for rapid response assignments where speed of deployment outweighed the need for heavy protection. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
